title: Evaluation of Four Surgical Techniques in Primary Total Hip Arthroplasty
brief_summary: Current "Minimally Invasive THR" includes: (1) Minimally Invasive Two-Incision THR (MIS-2), (2) Minimally Invasive Modified Watson-Jones THR (MIS-WJ). In contrast, "mini-incision" utilizes smaller incision (\< 10 cm in definition) to perform the THR which can further be divided into mini-anterolateral (Mini-AL) and mini-posterolateral (Mini-PL).The purpose of this study is to investigate how MIS THR can affect the results of THR by a prospective randomized clinical trial. It is hoped that some new standards could be established for the total hip replacement surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Unilateral hip disease that is indicated for primary total hip arthroplasty.

Exclusion Criteria:

* A previous THA on the contralateral hip.
* Any condition contraindicated for primary total hip arthroplasty.
* Refuse to be randomized in the study arms.
